es: Organizar una guía práctica en pasos obligatorios, advertencias y recomendaciones.
Elegir have to, must o should según la fuerza comunicativa necesaria.
Redactar una guía autocontenida que explique reglas y consejos con razones.

You have to complete the checklist, but you don't have to bring supplies.

answer.text: Visitors have to sign in, but they don't have to bring supplies. They must wear closed shoes and mustn't enter the workshop alone. They should carry water and shouldn't touch hot tools because they can cause burns.
accepted: Visitors have to sign in, but they don't have to bring supplies. They must wear closed shoes and mustn't enter the workshop alone. They should carry water and shouldn't touch hot tools because they can cause burns.

Visitors must sign in and wear closed shoes; supplies are provided, so they do not have to bring any. They must not enter the workshop alone. They should take water and should avoid hot tools because burns are possible.

feedback.es: La guía integra necesidad, regla, prohibición, consejo y una razón preventiva.

origin.text: Requisito externo: registrarse. No es necesario traer materiales: se prestan. Regla: usar zapatos cerrados. Prohibición: entrar solo al taller. Consejos: llevar agua y no tocar herramientas calientes porque pueden quemar.

answer.text: Visitors have to sign in, but they don't have to bring supplies. They must wear a helmet and mustn't use the red door. They should arrive early and shouldn't run because the floor is wet.
accepted: Visitors have to sign in, but they don't have to bring supplies. They must wear a helmet and mustn't use the red door. They should arrive early and shouldn't run because the floor is wet.

Visitors have to register and must wear helmets; supplies are provided, so they do not have to bring any. They must not use the red door. They should come early and should avoid running because the floor is wet.
